title: Pancho Gonzalez, McEnroe and Nastase tempers
summary: A story of Pancho Gonzalez taking a woman's hat with a ball.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: My wife, Ellie, loves tennis. We go every now and then.

Do you know what I saw Pancho Gonzalez do one night out in L.A.? He was mad. He was playing a guy named Ray Moore from South Africa, and Ray Moore escaped with a set... He gave up a set to Ray Moore, and he was mad, and he walked over to the plastic wastebasket and he broke his

racquet on it. Some woman in the audience laughed. That's all he needed. And Pancho had a temper. He stopped and he turned around and he picked her our. She had a hat on. He said, "I see that hat. Keep it on." He went over and he picked out another racquet. "Give me a ball." He looked at her like this and he went WHAM -- took her hat. Didn't touch her. Just took her hat off! The place almost exploded! It was so funny.
McEnroe, he's a... And another guy that could do it, the only other guy I could put in that class -- Nastase.
Yeah, he's the one who started all that temper tantrum thing.

Nastase is one of the greatest tennis players I ever saw in my life. And crazy to boot. I'll bet he's a wild one to be out with. Can you imagine being in a... I've never been in one, one of those disco joints, like Gerulaitis and those guys go to. How can they stand it?
